baker_text_1.text: Ah, hola amigo… I’m testing a new receta today. Smells okay, no?

responses.text: Honestly… it smells a bit strange.

baker_routine_good.text: Heh, gracias. Maybe I’m improving, sí.

responses.text: You bake here all the time?

baker_routine_strange.text: Ay… yeah. Too much yeast, quizá. Still, I bake every day. Keeps the hands busy.

responses.text: You bake here all the time?

baker_every_day.text: Every day. Morning to night. Routine is good.

responses.text: Sounds like work helps you avoid thinking.

baker_tiring.text: Tiring? No… but quiet. Too quiet sometimes.

responses.text: A lot of people hide inside routine.

baker_talks.text: When I stop baking.. my head gets loud.

responses.text: What do you hear when it gets loud?

baker_talks_more.text: I hear that if I’m not useful… I’m nothing.

responses.text: You don’t stop being someone when you rest.

baker_crack.text: …Sí. Maybe that’s true. When I stop baking… my head gets loud.

baker_ending.text: …Gracias. I think I knew that. I just never said it out loud.

intro_0.text: Hmmm... So this is the village. Things seem fine to me...

intro_1.text: It's very quiet here. The rumours made it sound a lot more chaotic.

intro_2.text: Those cityfolk tend to exaggerate, though.

intro_3.text: I'm sure there's something I could help with.

intro_4.text: I should go speak to some of the villagers, find out what all that chatter was about...
